Featured — shipped and public

HistoGate stain-invariant tissue classifier

A 9-class colorectal H&E classifier that declines unfamiliar tissue instead of guessing — Beer-Lambert stain physics baked into training, a k-NN familiarity gate, conformal prediction sets. Served live from my own GPU. The three failed training runs are published in the repo, not hidden.
